title: Unit 408 — three bedroom directions (G, H, I)
overview: Three more fully sourced directions for Isah and Ivan, distinct from all twelve earlier schemes (BUD, DIST and ND A–C; D, E, F) and from the sibling sets JKL and MNO: G Graphite Steel — black steel, chalk, felt; H Travertine Blush — stone and blush; I Plum Lacquer — dark lacquer, plum, smoked glass. Every visible piece is a real catalogue product judged on its supplier photo; technical essentials stay common by agreement.
requirements: MANDATORY: finished 50 mm mattress, 72 × 78 inches (1828.8 × 1981.2 mm), on continuous flat support with no exposed slats or gaps. No thick mattress, topper or box spring.
All prices assume new purchases. Three distinct sets of visible furniture, bedside lamps, fixtures, mirrors, rugs, textiles, plants and decor. Matching bedside pairs within each design.
Closed practical bedside storage, armrests on every chair, compact console with sourced decor. No extra generic styling objects.
75-inch wall TV baseline; 65-inch minimum, 85-inch optional pending price and clearance checks. 65-inch reference saves ₱12,000 in merchandise before contingency.
Split AC at the window-side corner of the TV wall, with airflow directed away from sleepers. Installer must verify location and capacity.
Mirror on the wall return between the two perpendicular doors. Preserve native irregular geometry, both doors, closet and warm narrow-block parquet.
Common technical essentials are owner-approved. Existing Davies Beige blackout/voile treatment and concealed old window AC remain a fixed room requirement.
procurement_gates: No scheme is purchase-ready until the bed supplier accepts the exact 50 mm mattress on a continuous flat deck. Gavino (G) shows availability=false and only White in photos; Frances (H) is listed Grey but photographs sand-taupe; Griffin II (I) has slats over a drawer base and needs a deck board. King outer sizes are unpublished for Gavino and Frances (plans use assumed outers).

Prices are frozen catalogue references (live-Airtable snapshot 20 Oct 2026) with each line's own price date; beds were read from supplier JSON on 20–21 Oct 2026. Product existence and photos are verified; exact Cebu stock, address delivery and checkout totals are not.

Colour, variant and size gates: Journey SHY1 Silk Grey (listing variant Black); Youset White Marble (listed Black Marble); Parker duvet is a Queen listing (King to confirm); every duvet cover and insert in King; Kartell Clap footprint; Tripod HM9 height; HÖGVIND table lamp and Kelly chair are catalogue-listed only; Kelly 890 mm width is conditional in the window corner.
TV mount is the True Vision TV73-69F; installer to confirm substrate, anchors and Samsung fixings.
Curtain ₱42,420 is the carried 16 October quote reference: ₱36,720 master treatment plus ₱3,800 valance and ₱1,900 sticks allocations. Remeasurement quote required.
Trade/freight/mattress/deck reserves total ₱35,000–84,000 as estimator allowances, not supplier quotations. 10 % contingency added, totals rounded up to the next ₱1,000.
Boards, measured plans and the AI style renders (sketch-to-render over the deterministic model views, read for character, not millimetres) are the review basis.

schemes.title: Graphite Steel
schemes.rationale: Chalk-white tufted Gavino bed and a plain white duvet against anthracite powder-coated steel: GRÅFJÄLLET door bedsides, a FJÄLLBO mesh-door console and a slim black floor mirror. A graphite embossed-felt Kartell Clap armchair, a storm-grey chunky wool cushion and a grey-black TANNISBY kilim give the felt-and-wool texture. Light is directional: two black Tripod HM9 angled task lamps and a dark HEKTAR industrial pendant. Two brushed-black frames over the bed hold the owners' own black-and-white photographs; a spiky agave in a cement bowl softens the console. Squint phrase: black steel, chalk, felt.
fit_notes: GRÅFJÄLLET bedsides 450×360 each side of the Gavino King; Gavino outer size not published, fit uses the mattress envelope.
FJÄLLBO 1500 mm console passes the ≤1600 mm short-console rule on the TV wall.
A58000434 floor mirror 387 mm wide on the 690 mm door return leaves ≈ 150 mm each side.
Kartell Clap armchair footprint unpublished (compact dining-lounge shell); confirm ≤ 850 mm in the window corner.

schemes.title: Travertine Blush
schemes.rationale: Frances bed with a big curved wraparound headboard in warm sand-taupe upholstery (listed Grey; the supplier photo reads sand), taupe percale bedding on a soft low-pile leaf rug; stone surfaces carry the room: sintered-stone Venice bedsides, a white-marble Youset console, a marble-banded Emilia mirror and a stone-textured round wall piece. Blush is the single accent, on one coral-blush striped cushion and one blush-banded ceramic vase. Light is frosted: opal-globe Journey SHY1 bedside lamps and a three-globe SIMRISHAMN opal pendant. A soft beige Heather armchair with a back pillow sits in the window corner. Squint phrase: stone and blush.
fit_notes: Venice bedsides 500×400 each side of the Frances King (published King outer not confirmed; fit uses the mattress envelope plus wings).
Youset 1400 mm console passes the short-console rule.
Emilia 600 mm mirror on the 690 mm return leaves ≈ 45 mm each side.
ÄLSKEGRAS 160×230 rug leaves parquet margins on all sides.

schemes.title: Plum Lacquer
schemes.rationale: Charcoal button-tufted wingback Griffin II on a walnut drawer base, dressed in a quiet grey quilt cover with a plum-and-lilac handwoven Pintig cushion and a 1.8 m dark-red eucalyptus branch in a smoked-grey glass floor vase. Dark case goods: black-brown KULLEN two-drawer bedsides and a black Sigma Senor console. Smoked glass is the light: HÖGVIND grey-glass table lamps and the matching three-lamp HÖGVIND pendant. A dark-grey Kelly swivel tub chair, a black wavy Sabrina floor mirror, a dark RÅVAROR stripe flatweave with fine wine-red lines and one large black-and-grey abstract canvas over the bed. Squint phrase: dark lacquer, plum, smoked glass.
fit_notes: KULLEN bedsides 350×400 each side of the Griffin II King (drawer base, slats: CONDITIONAL flat deck).
Sigma Senor I 1230 mm console passes the short-console rule.
Sabrina 606 mm floor mirror on the 690 mm return leaves ≈ 42 mm each side.
Kelly 890×910 tub chair is over the 850 mm guide; conditional like F's LANDSKRONA — confirm the window-corner clearance.
